scientific_integrity: Analytic complete exact-arithmetic classification. Rational and seeded numerical checks supplement but do not certify infinite-time results. Prior alpha=1 dynamics are credited and excluded.
scientific_limitations: Two-row real isotropic quadratic and exact nuclear-scaled polar updates at 0<alpha<2, alpha not equal to 1. Exact rank-loss resonances need exact arithmetic. Does not cover anisotropic matrices, other dimensions, momentum, or finite-precision rank errors.
title: Exact finite-transient two-cycle and resonant rank loss for two-row PolarGrad
